text:
incident-bot: INC00123 — P1 — increased 5xx rate from hosted inference cluster in us-west-2. paging alice_oncall and bob_sre. auto-escalation timer started.

alice_oncall: looking. seeing spike at 14:12 UTC, 5xx ~ 18% sustained. routing errors + timeouts. can someone grab the latest deploy diffs?

bob_sre: on it. pulling deploy history. nothing scheduled at 14:00–14:20 besides a small canary earlier. checking autoscaler logs.

charlie_eng: fyi I rolled a config patch to kv-cache last night but that was 02:00 UTC. not in the 14:xx window. I'll check model-variant routing rules though.

alice_oncall: immediate mitigation: enabling traffic fallback to smaller model variant for public API route /v1/generate to reduce backend timeouts. applying now.

bob_sre: redirect rule applied to canary: true. monitor group, please watch tail of proxy errors.

frank_support: getting DMs from a customer (org: clearcloud) with timeout errors in their integration. they reported around 14:13 UTC. letting them know we're investigating.

alice_oncall: metrics: error rate dropping to ~4% after fallback at 14:19 UTC, latency improved but some increased cost. marking customer-impact=true.

incident-bot: NOTE — incident set to "Mitigated" at 14:21 UTC by alice_oncall. recording timeline.

dana_security: quick note — while we triage, please don't rotate keys or delete logs. need to preserve for potential evidence.

bob_sre: agreed. snapshotting observability state and exporting the relevant traces now.

charlie_eng: I see a flurry of KV cache eviction errors just before the spike. possible memory pressure on the inference runtime leading to request panics.

alice_oncall: can you paste the log sample? include the request ids for impacted spans so we can correlate to audit logs.

charlie_eng: attaching snippets inline:

```
runtime: evicting kv cache entry shard-12, mem_used 94%
panic: failed to allocate token buffer
trace_id=tr_0a3f4b, req_id=req-9f2a3b
```

bob_sre: running export command to collect logs for window 14:00–14:25 UTC:
```
redwood-cli logs export --service inference-runtime --start 2025-06-15T14:00:00Z --end 2025-06-15T14:25:00Z --out /tmp/INC00123_logs.tar.gz
```

alice_oncall: frank_support, please compile customer list affected and severity (timeouts, errors, degraded). we need customer-impact table for the postmortem.

frank_support: already on it. preliminary: 8 customers affected, 2 high-impact (timeouts causing transaction failures), others intermittent failures. sending CSV shortly.

incident-bot: Reminder — create postmortem in #postmortems when incident is closed.

alice_oncall: let's not close until we have evidence packaged and security approves retention. dana_security, can you confirm audit log coverage? specifically need API gateway access logs, deploy history, and control-plane audit logs for 13:50–14:30 UTC.

dana_security: checking. preliminary: control-plane audit logs show a 3-minute gap 14:05–14:08 UTC for the VPC collector (ingestion backlog). that may impact completeness. I'm pulling raw agent buffers now to see if we can recover.

bob_sre: that's problematic. if we have a log gap for control-plane, we need to preserve every available source and note the gap in evidence.

charlie_eng: I can provide runtime snapshots and the kernel traces we captured. also have the probe outputs for shard-12.

alice_oncall: good. immediate action items (quick):
- alice_oncall: keep fallback in place until a safe rollout (owner: alice_oncall, due: 2025-06-16)
- bob_sre: export all infra logs and heap profiles for runtime nodes in us-west-2 for 13:45–14:30 UTC (owner: bob_sre, due: 2025-06-15 18:00 UTC)
- charlie_eng: reproduce locally with kv-cache stress harness and add guard for mem pressure (owner: charlie_eng, due: 2025-06-20)
- dana_security: verify audit log buffer and try to reconstruct missing control-plane entries (owner: dana_security, due: 2025-06-16)
- frank_support: finalize affected customer list and prepare customer-facing incident note draft (owner: frank_support, due: 2025-06-15 20:00 UTC)

ellen_product: scheduling a postmortem meeting. propose 2025-06-17 15:00 UTC (30m). can we lock that?

alice_oncall: I can make that. prefer 45m.

dana_security: security will attend. need to review evidence chain before final external statement.

bob_sre: note for ticketing: create remediation tracking ticket in JIRA with label INC00123 and link to exports bucket.

charlie_eng: quick workaround note for ops in case of recurrence: add an emergency route that fails fast to 429 on heavy memory pressure rather than allowing panics (prevents cascading timeouts). I'll PR this as a quick change.

frank_support: customer-facing draft (wip):
"At ~14:12 UTC on 2025-06-15, a subset of requests to the Redwood hosted inference cluster in us-west-2 experienced elevated errors/timeouts due to a runtime memory pressure event. We applied a fallback to a compatible model variant to restore availability. We're continuing an investigation and will follow up with a postmortem including mitigation and timeframe." 

alice_oncall: looks good; dana_security sign-off before send.

dana_security: will sign off after I verify audit log reconstruction. if we can't fully reconstruct control-plane logs we'll note that in the evidence section and keep repeatable artifacts (heap profiles, runtime traces, export tarball).

incident-bot: ACTIONS logged: 5 open actions. Reminder: set severity to P1 in postmortem doc.

bob_sre: export completed to s3://redwood-incidents/INC00123_logs.tar.gz (checksum: sha256:abcd1234...). documenting location in ticket.

charlie_eng: uploaded heap dumps to same bucket: heapdump-node-3-14_15.gz.

alice_oncall: timeline so far (for postmortem):
- 14:12 UTC — error rate spike begins
- 14:13 UTC — customers report timeouts
- 14:16 UTC — KV cache eviction errors increase
- 14:19 UTC — fallback to smaller model variant enabled
- 14:21 UTC — mitigation observed, error rate drops
- 14:25 UTC — mitigation holding; monitoring

ellen_product: postmortem doc created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC00123-POSTMORTEM (placeholder). please add notes and owners.

frank_support: final customer communication queued, awaiting security sign-off. will not send until after dana confirms.

alice_oncall: dana, if you can't recover control-plane entries, please advise on alternate evidence language. we need to be transparent.

dana_security: if reconstruction fails, we'll include: what was recovered, what is missing, steps taken to preserve evidence, and planned improvements to avoid log gaps (owner: dana_security, due: 2025-07-01). also proposing an internal audit of the VPC collector reliability.

bob_sre: creating monitoring alert to detect collector backlog > 2m (owner: bob_sre, due: 2025-06-18).

charlie_eng: quick PR link for fail-fast behaviour: https://github.com/redwood/inference-runtime/pull/3284 (wip).

alice_oncall: thanks everyone. keeping thread open until postmortem scheduled and all critical actions assigned. summary will be appended to the postmortem doc once we confirm audit log status. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident state: Mitigated -> Postmortem pending.
